hotels.title: Hoi An Ancient Town Riverside Retreat with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Cocktails & Massages
hotels.description: Perched on the banks of the Hoai River in the heart of Hoi An Ancient Town, Moire Hoi An brings IHG's neighbourhood-inspired Vignette Collection to one of Vietnam's most storied cities. Start the morning at Bistro Julienne before heading out into the colourful alleyways, silk shops and fragrant street food stalls that make this corner of Vietnam one of Southeast Asia's most beloved. Return for poolside cocktails at Ember & Sip as the Ancient Town's evening energy builds, and let Breathe Spa bring the calm before another day begins. When the UNESCO Heritage-listed Ancient Town calls for a change of pace, An Bang Beach is just a short drive away for a proper stretch of Vietnamese coastline, and Da Nang makes for an easy day trip, where the impressive Dragon Bridge greets visitors. At nearby Ba Na Hills, the giant hands of the Golden Bridge carry you across the landscape, and the Marble Mountains offer natural scenery just outside the city.

hotels.title: Five-Star Hoi An Opulence on Hoai River with Restaurant, Bar & Pool with Ancient Town Views
hotels.description: Retreat to the banks of the Hoai River at this enchanting escape designed to embrace the very best of this vibrant Vietnamese town. With hints of local architecture intertwined with sleek modern features, this charming hotel is the perfect riverside abode, just minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hoi An Ancient Town. Savour Mediterranean flavours at the onsite restaurant, sip cocktails by the pool and take a moment of rest at Breathe Spa - here, there's no reason to rush.
